title: Combining two logarithms
source: P23 Ch2 theory P23-2.4 Quick check 1 (log2 x + log2 5 = log2 40, x=8)
stem: Solve the equation given by the logarithm to base {a|int} of x, plus the logarithm to base {a|int} of {b|int}, equals the logarithm to base {a|int} of {N|int}.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The multiplication law of logarithms gives the logarithm of {b|int} times x, so {b|int}x={N|int}.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: Hence x={k|int}. This value is positive, so the logarithms are defined.

title: A logarithm equal to an integer
source: P23 Ch2 theory P23-2.4 Quick check 2 (log3(x+2)=2, x=7)
stem: Solve the equation given by the logarithm to base {a|int} of (x+{c|int}) equals {k|int}.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: In exponential form, x+{c|int} is {a|int} to the power {k|int}.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: Hence x={E|int}. The argument is positive, so the logarithm is defined.

contexts.stem: Find x if the logarithm to base {a|int} of x+{c|int} is {k|int}.

title: A power law and a rejected root
source: P23 Ch2 theory P23-2.4 Quick check 3 (2 log5(x-1)=log5 36, x=7; x=-5 rejected)
stem: Solve the equation 2 times the logarithm to base {a|int} of (x-{c|int}) equals the logarithm to base {a|int} of {M|int}.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The power law gives (x-{c|int}) squared equals {M|int}, so x-{c|int} is {s|int} or -{s|int}.
steps.note: Use the power law and square roots.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: The value x={c|int}-{s|int} makes the argument zero or negative, so it is rejected. The solution is x={E|int}.
